label: token right after an early g (orig position 3-4) in the input phase
explanation: Fires only in the original-input phase, on the step right after a g was input, almost entirely at position 3 (84% of mass) or 4 (14%); weak at position 2, essentially never later, never in the delimiter/copy phases. 98% of activation mass has prev_tok == g. But most such steps (~86%) stay inactive: magnitude is modulated by earlier context, highest when the sequence starts with m (top examples m ? g x), with prev2 = v, or with the current token x (also q, digits 2/3). Adding these context terms raises precision to ~0.55 but loses recall, so no clean gate was found. Does not fire after other tokens or after a g later in the sequence.

scorecard.summary: Weighted combination of 40 cues. Raise it: prev_tok=g (+6.91), orig0=m (+4.48), prev2_tok=v (+3.55), t=3 & prev_tok=g (+3.38), prev_tok=3 (+2.67), orig0=d (+2.60). Lower it: orig_idx=-1 (-4.15), orig0=2 (-3.32), orig0=l (-3.20), orig0=u (-3.07).
